papers.abstract_zh: This new generation hand is the perfect companion for Atlas. With 13 degrees of freedom, these hands are directly actuated, built for high fidelity simulation to enable sim-to-real RL, and designed from the ground up for dexterous physical work. Learn how we built robot hands for modern AI and real work: https://bostondynamics.com/blog/robot-hands-for-modern-ai-and-real-work
